summary.title: DevDocs
summary.one_liner: DevDocs is a free, open-source, offline-capable web app that combines many API documentation sets into one fast, searchable interface.
takeaways: DevDocs bundles documentation for 100+ languages and libraries (e.g. HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, Ruby, Python, Go, C, C++) in one web app.
Search supports fuzzy matching, so abbreviated queries like 'bgcp' find 'background-clip'.
Type a doc's name or abbreviation then press Tab to search only that documentation; keyboard shortcuts are available via '?'.
DevDocs works offline, on mobile, and can be installed as a web app; you can also search it from the browser address bar.
It is free and open source, and is listed under Tools in charlax/professional-programming (noted alongside Dash for macOS).
summary.summary: The DevDocs page is a welcome screen for the DevDocs web app, which merges multiple API documentation sets into one searchable interface. It lists getting-started tips: enabling more docs and customizing the UI in Preferences, keyboard-driven navigation, fuzzy search, per-doc search via Tab, browser address bar search, and offline/mobile/installable use. The page states the project is free and open source and asks users to star it on GitHub. The page itself contains no technical detail beyond these usage notes.
